"Iranian attacks on shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz have surged in October to date, with more than two dozen vessels struck since the month began. The uptick in Iranian strikes is an effort to counter a rebound in oil flows that showed Tehran's grip on the Strait of Hormuz was weakening."

"After 40 days of war, Trump declared victory and announced a two-week ceasefire on 8 April. The ceasefire quickly collapsed as Washington imposed a naval blockade on Iranian ports and Iran intensified missile strikes on US bases. Hostilities continued until Pakistan brokered a 14-point Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding on 14 June, signed remotely by Presidents Donald Trump and Masoud Pezeshkian on 17 June."
